summary: Scholastic Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a private share repurchase from the Estate of M. Richard Robinson, Jr., its former Chairman and CEO. The company bought 289,624 common shares at $39.7603 per share, a 3% discount to the $40.99 close, totaling $11.5 million, representing ~1.6% of outstanding shares. The transaction was approved by the Audit Committee of independent directors, excluding Chair Iole Lucchese, who is a preliminary co-executor. It was executed under the existing $300 million repurchase authorization, leaving ~$158.9 million. This buyback reduces overhang, and investors should watch for further estate-block sales or ongoing repurchase activity.
